landing.title: Every vehicle, driver and request in one place
landing.subtitle: FMS keeps the fleet database, inspections, daily use, fuel, maintenance, training, HR records and safety data together, with approvals and reminders that follow your roles.
landing.feature.fleet.title: Fleet database
landing.feature.fleet.body: One page per vehicle: details, inspection status, insurance, maintenance schedule, documents and remarks, with expiry reminders.
landing.feature.drivers.title: Driver details
landing.feature.drivers.body: Profiles with training, licences, OSHA fit-for-work and documents. Drivers see and update only their own data from their phone.
landing.feature.inspections.title: Inspections
landing.feature.inspections.body: Daily pre-trip checks, third-party inspections and first aid kits. An anomaly marked Immediately flags the vehicle as not safe for use.
landing.feature.daily_use.title: Vehicle daily use
landing.feature.daily_use.body: Kilometre logs, fuel requests and trip requests with manager approval and the three-step journey management plan for long trips.
landing.feature.expenses.title: Expenses and administration
landing.feature.expenses.body: Fuel, maintenance, tyres, washing, equipment, training, timesheets, leave and incidents, each with its own approvals and reports.
landing.feature.access.title: Access is data, not code
landing.feature.access.body: Owners and admins set what every role can view, add, edit, delete, approve and export per module, down to the submodule and scope.
landing.roles_body: Owner, Admin, Fleet coordinator, Head of department, Driver, HR, Requester, HSE manager, Control room operator and Emergency response commander each see only what they need.
landing.steps.1.title: Record
landing.steps.1.body: Drivers and coordinators log inspections, trips, fuel and requests from any device.
landing.steps.2.title: Approve
landing.steps.2.body: Managers approve or reject with a required reason and an electronic signature.
landing.steps.3.title: Track
landing.steps.3.body: Dashboards, reminders and exportable reports show cost, compliance and safety at a glance.
